elderSaphyrian.name: Elder Saphyrian
elderSaphyrian.title: Keeper of the Barrier
elderSaphyrian.description: Ancient dragon who understands the Barrier's power. She guides the Final Flight and manages the Arcana that sustains Draconia.

masterThalorin.name: Master Thalorin
masterThalorin.title: Forge Master
masterThalorin.description: Expert craftsman who forges dragon equipment. His knowledge of metalwork is unparalleled.

scholarVynara.name: Scholar Vynara
scholarVynara.title: Keeper of Knowledge
scholarVynara.description: Head librarian of the Ancient Library. She preserves the collective knowledge of dragonkind.
scholarVynara.greeting: Knowledge awaits those who seek it.

merchantKael.name: Merchant Kael
merchantKael.title: Master Trader
merchantKael.description: Shrewd merchant who runs the general store. Always has something useful for sale.

healerMyria.name: Healer Myria
healerMyria.title: Guardian of Wellness
healerMyria.description: Compassionate healer who tends to wounded dragons. Her healing pools can cure any ailment.
healerMyria.greeting: Rest here, brave one. You are safe.

enchanterZephyr.name: Enchanter Zephyr
enchanterZephyr.title: Master of Mysteries
enchanterZephyr.description: Enigmatic enchanter who imbues items with magical properties. His methods are ancient and powerful.
enchanterZephyr.greeting: The arcane arts await your discovery.

captainDrakon.name: Captain Drakon
captainDrakon.title: Training Master
captainDrakon.description: Veteran warrior who trains new Guardians. His combat expertise is legendary.

unknown.title: Unknown
unknown.description: A mysterious figure shrouded in shadow.
